title: R2 fix: AES-CBC/CTR IV not updated after encrypt
description: After crypto2dev_cipher() completes AES-CBC encrypt, aes->reg must be updated to the last ciphertext block so chained multi-call CBC is correct. For decrypt, update to last ciphertext (input) block. For CTR mode, advance aes->reg counter by data_sz/AES_BLOCK_SIZE blocks. Without this, second and subsequent wc_AesCbcEncrypt calls on same Aes object use the original IV (wrong output).
